### CI

The tab lists the runs imported from the app's CI — status, run, branch, commit, trigger, when, duration, linked to the server — ten per page, paged on the API; **Sync** imports the latest. **Connect CI** (later **Change CI**) opens its own page: the runner — a **CI server** the organization connected under Settings (Jenkins), or the one embedded in the source host (GitHub Actions, with the host's own token) — and the **job**: the path in the Jenkins URL (`team/app`, `team/app/main` for a multibranch branch) or a workflow file such as `ci.yml` (empty means every workflow). Runs are imported into the platform; nothing is triggered from here.
